svg.text: Completion 8% (10 of 119 items implemented or verified) · Verified 0% (0) · Current milestone: M0 — Foundation
Generated from progress/progress.toml by tools/progress-gen. Completion = (implemented + verified) / total; floored.

g.title: M0 — Foundation: Partial — Stage A: workspace, hygiene, progress tooling, docs, Windows gate, CI, source root.

rect.title: M1 — Evidence: Investigating — Stage B: regulatory and official sources catalogued, official mobile software inventoried, formats identified.
M2 — Import: Not started — Stage C: source scanner, manifest, extraction, normalised local asset layout, repeatable importer.

g.title: M3 — Headless game model: Partial — Stage D: state, spin, awards, feature state machine, deterministic traces. Runs on a synthetic fixture only; original mathematics unknown.

rect.title: M4 — Golden Century Bevy slice: Not started — Stage E: title boots, UI, reels, spin, imported local assets, audio, win and feature presentation.
M5 — Parity: Not started — Stage F: source-vs-rewrite traces, timing, screenshots, animation and audio events, discrepancies tracked.
M6 — Portability: Not started — Stage G: Windows verified, Linux and macOS build and test, Web/WASM builds and runs.
M7 — Happy & Prosperous, Panda Magic, Autumn Moon: Not started — Generalise the systems proven on Golden Century to the other three titles.
Foundation / Repository bootstrap (workspace, licence, toolchain pin) — Implemented
Foundation / Legal and project policy — Implemented
Foundation / Evidence labels and provenance rules — Implemented
Foundation / Private source root outside Git — Not started — Layout is specified in docs/SOURCES.md; the tool that creates and checks it is not written yet.

g.title: Foundation / Windows development environment (reproducible) — Partial — Rust 1.98.0, MSVC build tools, wasm32 target, Git, Python, Java, ffmpeg present; tools/dev/setup-windows.ps1 reports and installs. RE applications not installed yet.

rect.title: Foundation / Windows pre-merge gate — Implemented — fmt, clippy, test, hygiene, progress check today; app, smoke, wasm and release steps switch on when the app exists.

g.title: Foundation / CI (Linux, Windows, macOS, wasm32 check) — Partial — Workflow is written; it has not run yet because nothing has been pushed (docs/BLOCKERS.md).

rect.title: Foundation / Repository hygiene checker — Implemented
Foundation / Progress tracker and generator — Implemented
Foundation / Prior-art review (ASAMU-decomp, rea, universal-modder) — Implemented

g.title: Reverse engineering / Dragon Link cabinet and platform research — Partial — Three Australian generations and their platforms established from ACT instruments (docs/reverse-engineering/PLATFORMS.md); launch cabinet and what changed between generations unknown.

Reverse engineering / Regulatory source inventory — Partial — ACT and Victorian approvals catalogued with identifiers (docs/reverse-engineering/REGULATORY.md); no register found for NSW, Qld, SA, Tas, NT, WA; no RTP in any source.

rect.title: Reverse engineering / Official mobile reference inventory — Investigating — Four official apps identified from store listings (docs/reverse-engineering/MOBILE_REFERENCE.md). Nothing downloaded or inspected; acquisition needs the owner (BLOCKERS B-003).
Reverse engineering / Source provenance database (claims) — Implemented
Reverse engineering / Package and file-format identification — Not started
Reverse engineering / Executable analysis — Not started
Reverse engineering / Asset-container identification — Not started
Reverse engineering / Texture and image extraction — Not started

Reverse engineering / Animation extraction — Not started
Reverse engineering / Configuration and data extraction — Not started
Reverse engineering / Mathematical-model investigation — Investigating — The mathematics is not public and is asserted as trade secrets (docs/reverse-engineering/math/EVIDENCE_STATE.md).
Shared game runtime / Outcome source abstraction (test, record, replay) — Implemented — Test instruments of ours. Models nothing about the original generator, which is unknown.

g.title: Shared game runtime / State machine — Partial — Idle and Hold & Spin phases with transactional commands; no free games, attract or idle states.
Shared game runtime / Credits / play-credit model — Partial — A play-credit meter with chained credit events; denominations and cash handling are not modelled.
Shared game runtime / Bet selection — Partial — Credits per line over all lines; the original's bet structure is unknown.
Shared game runtime / Spin lifecycle — Partial — Bet, reel stops, awards, feature entry, completion as events; ordering is ours, not evidenced.
Shared game runtime / Reel model — Partial — Strips with a wrapping window; how the original maps outcomes to stops is unknown.
Shared game runtime / Symbol model — Partial — Regular, wild, scatter and orb kinds; title symbol sets are unknown.
Shared game runtime / Pay evaluator — Partial — Generic left-to-right line rules and scatter pays, each stated in eval.rs; none checked against the original.

rect.title: Shared game runtime / Win presentation — Not started

g.title: Shared game runtime / Feature triggering — Partial — Hold & Spin by orb count only.
Shared game runtime / Hold & Spin framework — Partial — Parameterised respin loop with tests; trigger count, respins, chances and values are synthetic.
Shared game runtime / Jackpot model and presentation — Partial — Four named levels with fixed amounts; progressive meters and presentation are not started.

g.title: Shared game runtime / Save and settings handling — Partial — Game state serialises and resumes mid-feature; no settings, no persistence in an app.

Golden Century / Title identity, versions and regulatory identifiers — Partial — Four ACT specifications and two Victorian builds recorded (docs/reverse-engineering/GOLDEN_CENTURY.md); other jurisdictions and what changed between generations unknown.
